selectionReason: Nov 20 broad semiconductor selloff makes HL001's thesis-versus-volatility discipline useful; Infineon's Nov 10 signed-plus-negotiated capacity claim makes HL012's independent verification essential. Neither repeats Nov 21 HL003/HL006; no claim of price prediction.

cards.title: The thesis must survive daily gyrations
cards.question: What makes a thesis stronger than a daily price move?
cards.selfCheck: Write both buy and avoid cases, with milestones and disconfirming evidence. A thesis should survive ordinary volatility unless its underlying assumptions change.
cards.prompt: Explain the lesson with the Nov 20 semiconductor selloff versus Infineon's Nov 10 disclosed data-center revenue and capacity commitments. Distinguish share-price volatility from changes in power-chip demand; identify disconfirming operating evidence. https://www.infineon.com/press-release/2026/infpr202611-025

cards.title: Use multiple independent research channels
cards.question: How can you reduce single-source bias?
cards.selfCheck: Cross-check primary company materials, credible analysis, and industry discussion. Keep facts separate from speculation.
cards.prompt: Explain how to validate Infineon's Nov 10 €10B signed-plus-negotiated capacity reservations using filings, customer confirmations, future shipment data and cash flows. Explain why negotiations are not firm orders. https://www.infineon.com/assets/row/public/documents/corporate/investors/presentations/2026/2026-11-10-q4-fy26-intro-statement-analyst-call-v01-00-en.pdf
